status: Read-only design assessment, no implementation or fit authorized by this artifact
priority: Below the active raw-sequence experiment and successful new-input families; optional cheap architectural falsification

distinctness.versus_forced_residual: The direct clipped response, mean normalization and exact N09 initial output remain unchanged; zero initialized gates can ignore every clock. The failed arm forced a clock offset into every fitted response and changed target conditioning.
distinctness.versus_sensor_differences: Clock values reach the output multiplicatively in their physical scale, bypassing numeric rank/quantile transforms. The sensor arm only adds independently encoded affine differences.
distinctness.information: No new observations or label information; the hypothesis is a more economical parameterization of conditional clock calibration already learnable approximately by N09.

possible_frozen_screen.base: Unmodified original156-input N09 and ordinary population; direct min(y,10800), original OneCycle24 horizon, fixed Jan21/Jul17 epochs, seed42k0
possible_frozen_screen.eligibility: Finite physical interval in [0,10800] seconds, using existing source availability/match flags where applicable. AOBT requires original provenance; no schedule fallback, label-based gate, day anchor or copied clock.
possible_frozen_screen.initialization: Original N09 first; all new W and b exactly zero without consuming dropout/initialization RNG. Initial output and original parameter gradients exactly match the control.
possible_frozen_screen.boundedness: Four gate magnitudes at most0.25 and clipped contrasts imply at most3600 seconds extra correction; missing clocks contribute exactzero. The model is never forced to take a stale clock.
possible_frozen_screen.loss: Same mean squared error only; no auxiliary target or new regularization search
comparisons: fair half candidate versus half matched control
possible_frozen_screen.fallback_caveat: With joint training, the shared N09 branch may change even where every clock is absent; only the additional term is guaranteed zero there.
possible_frozen_screen.runtime_estimate: About4-6 minutes for both fixed fits plus standard encoding/scoring, following an initial equality/gradient test; no sequence scan required

evidence_against_high_priority.physical_agreement_slices: All24 saved slices favor v58 over the raw AOBT, physical witness and their mean. Even agreement within60seconds is insufficient: Jan ADSB-stand subset v58 RMSE54.59 versus clock mean99.32; July128.05 versus181.16.
evidence_against_high_priority.missing_clock_cost: Original-AOBT missing rows hold68.42% of January SSE and31.26% of July SSE; an AOBT-only bypass does not add information on these rows.
evidence_against_high_priority.interpretation: Repairing rare extrapolation alone cannot credibly explain a five-second gain. A large gain would require broad improvement among common clocks, where current direct-model calibration is already much better than the clocks. Coarse-slice results do not exclude a learnable finer subgroup, but provide no positive evidence for it.
